description: lot GTFS is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by David Ménissez. Données GTFS du réseau STIBUS, fournissant la description complète de l’offre de transport (lignes, arrêts, horaires, calendriers, correspondances) pour la période du 2 mars au 31 août 2026. Ce format standardisé permet l’exploitation des données par les plateformes MaaS, calculateurs d’itinéraires, systèmes d’information voyageurs et outils d’analyse de la mobilité. Coverage: David Ménissez. The publisher named on the listing is David Ménissez. Its keywords include horaires, donnees-ouvertes, arrets, mobilite, transports-en-commun, lignes-de-bus. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2026-03-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
